motivation.statement: The prior 50-wallet study showed cumulative-deposit ROI can understate high-turnover capital efficiency and did not constitute an all-eligible-pool top-operator census. This protocol freezes the replacement methodology before collecting the new census or producing the new operator rankings.

universe.pool_census: exhaust every observable /pools page satisfying the fixed economic filters, then retain every SOL-paired pool; no fixed pool-count sample

lp_activity_census.wallet_selection: every distinct authenticated LP signer observed in supported add/remove/rebalance DLMM activity; no per-pool wallet cap and no outcome-based selection
lp_activity_census.completeness: A pool is complete when 32 readable finalized transaction bodies are obtained, or when fewer exist and every available eligible finalized signature is read successfully with no unreadable transaction.
lp_activity_census.checkpoint: pool-by-pool atomic checkpoint; resumable only when the exact protocol signature and discovered pool list match

outcome_window.open_positions: diagnostic only; may not improve ranking

primary_rankings.definition: after-network-cost realized PnL USD divided by integrated USD capital-at-risk hours
cash-flow-neutral chain-linked realized return using preregistered event-time capital segments; never cumulative-deposit ROI
maximum peak-to-trough drawdown of chronological cumulative after-network-cost realized PnL
profitable 7-day realized-PnL buckets divided by active 7-day buckets

capital_at_risk.source: Meteora position historical events plus authenticated Solana transaction instruction/event evidence
capital_at_risk.add: increase bin-level contributed-capital basis by event-time USD deposit, allocated according to authenticated liquidity distribution when available
capital_at_risk.remove: reduce contributed-capital basis only for the authenticated removed range/share; full close must leave zero contributed basis
capital_at_risk.integration: piecewise integrate concurrent contributed-capital basis across all open positions for a wallet
capital_at_risk.recycled_capital_rule: capital withdrawn before later redeployment is not simultaneously counted; redeployment creates a new later exposure segment
capital_at_risk.fail_closed: wallet capital-efficiency ranking is unavailable if event history or required on-chain mutation evidence is incomplete

pnl_decomposition.fee_income_usd: sum allTimeFees.total.usd for measured closed positions
pnl_decomposition.inventory_token_price_pnl_usd: API realized PnL USD minus fee income USD
pnl_decomposition.network_execution_cost_usd: unique authenticated LP transaction meta.fee converted using event-time SOL/USD when available
pnl_decomposition.after_network_cost_pnl_usd: API realized PnL USD minus network execution cost USD

entry_and_management_features: explicit Spot/Curve/Bid-Ask strategy type when encoded
preregistered Spot/Curve/Bid-Ask-like shape classification for custom distributions
nearest authenticated dynamic-fee observation at or before entry
fee/TVL at entry when point-in-time evidence is available; otherwise explicit unavailable
token age at entry when source creation time is available

operator_candidates.union_rule: union of the top 25 eligible wallets in each primary ranking; ties at rank 25 are retained
operator_candidates.deep_reconstruction: every candidate must have complete capital-at-risk, PnL decomposition, entry-state, rebalance and exit reconstruction before it can contribute to rule derivation

fleet_clustering.goal: avoid treating coordinated multi-wallet implementations as independent strategy evidence
features: shared funding or fee-payer evidence when directly observable
fleet_clustering.conservative_rule: clustering may merge evidence units but may never split one wallet into extra independent support; uncertain relationships remain separate and flagged uncertain

rule_derivation.outputs: one or more frozen candidate rules only when repeatable behavior is supported across independent operator clusters
rule_derivation.prospective_test: natural future DLMM observations using unchanged paper-only authority; no rule editing after prospective outcomes begin
